property_summary: For any nonzero address caller and any newOwner, if we first set c.owner to that caller by calling transferOwnership from the current owner (deployed contract with default owner 0), then a subsequent transferOwnership(newOwner) call made by that same caller must succeed and set owner to newOwner in the reference; the mutant that only allows address(0) as caller will sometimes prevent this (i.e., for caller != address(0)) causing owner to differ.
change_summary: Change the onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender be the zero address, so only the zero address may call transferOwnership (practically blocking normal calls).
